goblin.name: Goblin
goblin.description: Attacks whoever taunted it, then the Warrior, then the lowest-HP target

ogre.name: Ogre
ogre.description: Smash: hits the taunter hard. Every 3rd round its hit also knocks the target prone (skips next turn)

warlock.name: Warlock
warlock.description: Goes after the Wizard or Cleric (lowest HP). Every 3rd round curses all heroes instead (−2 damage for 2 rounds)

hunter.name: Hunter
hunter.description: Ranged: ignores taunt and targets the lowest-armor hero

assassin.name: Assassin
assassin.description: Targets the lowest-HP hero; each hit drains 2 from that hero's pool

shaman.name: Shaman
shaman.description: Heals the most injured monster and shields its allies (+2 armor through the next round); attacks only when nothing is injured
